name: Chipotle
red_flags: Chart lists milk, wheat/gluten, soy and sulphites per item; page states no egg, peanut, tree nut, sesame, shellfish or fish ingredients but cannot guarantee absence. Dairy only in cheese, queso, sour cream; wheat only in flour tortillas. Corn items (chips, crispy taco shells, corn salsa) may carry trace gluten. Ask for a glove change.
likely_safe: Burrito bowl or salad: white or brown rice, black or pinto beans, chicken/steak/barbacoa/carnitas or sofritas, fajita veggies, tomato salsa, tomatillo salsas, guacamole, romaine (no flour tortilla, cheese, queso or sour cream)

name: Chick-fil-A
red_flags: Breaded chicken is fried in refined peanut oil (not flagged on the chart); ask about the fryer for fries. Chart has no shellfish column. Allergens tab on the nutrition table (no hide/filter). No shellfish column. Breaded chicken is cooked in refined peanut oil, which is not flagged as an allergen. Shared cooking and prep areas.
likely_safe: Waffle Potato Fries (fryer practice not stated on chart; ask)

name: McDonald's
red_flags: Allergen info shown per item inside the nutrition calculator, no allergen filter. States normal kitchen operations may involve shared cooking and prep. Live site blocks automated access; verified via Sept 2026 snapshot.

name: Wendy's
red_flags: No downloadable chart: allergens for the 9 FDA allergens are shown per item on the website/app menu. Cross-contact possible from common handling areas.

name: Taco Bell
red_flags: Select allergens to avoid (also MSG). Same equipment and kitchen areas used for egg, milk, soy, wheat products.

name: Subway
red_flags: Page links to the 'Allergy & Ingredient Info (USA)' PDF (Oct 2026). Wheat and gluten combined. Gluten-free bread is made in a GF facility but sandwiches are made on shared equipment; foods contact each other during prep.

name: Five Guys
red_flags: PEANUT RISK: fries are cooked in peanut oil and free peanuts are served in the dining room; peanut dust is everywhere. Not recommended for a peanut allergy. Malt vinegar on the condiment bar. PEANUT-HEAVY: fries cooked in 100% peanut oil and free in-shell peanuts in dining rooms; peanut butter shake mix-ins. Buns contain egg, milk, wheat. Malt vinegar on condiment bars. Made-to-order in kitchens that handle all listed allergens.

name: Shake Shack
red_flags: Link opens a hosted 'Master Nut & Allergen' PDF viewer (file dated 1/6/26) that could not be read automatically, so coverage is unconfirmed. Live site blocks bots; verified via Oct 2026 snapshot.

name: In-N-Out Burger
red_flags: One-page chart; only bun, cheese, spread, milk, shakes, creamers, cocoa and marshmallow carry allergens. States any item not listed has none of the 9 major allergens and no cross-contact risk, and allergens not listed are not used at all (so no fish/shellfish).
likely_safe: Hamburger Protein Style (lettuce wrap) without spread or cheese; add ketchup, mustard, onions, pickles, tomato

name: Culver's
red_flags: Lifestyle Filter to select several allergens to avoid (Nutritionix-powered). Busy kitchens, shared equipment. Custard flavors vary daily.

name: Sonic Drive-In
red_flags: Periodically updated PDF with Contains / May Contain marks and a 'Fried' column flagging cross-contact risk for all allergens from shared fryers. No item certified gluten-free.

name: Arby's
red_flags: Nutrition & Allergen Guide PDF plus a separate gluten-free guide and ingredients PDF. Per-item 'Contains / May contain' text; some items carry may-contain sesame. Few items free of all allergens.

name: Jack in the Box
red_flags: Nutrition facts PDF (Nov 2026) linked from homepage, with allergen letter codes per item (M, E, W, S, F, C=crustaceans, P, T, ss). Products may be prepared on equipment shared with egg, fish, milk, sesame, soy and wheat items.

name: Raising Cane's
red_flags: Fries and chicken share fry oil: fries 'may contain eggs, milk and wheat'. No shellfish column; peanuts and tree nuts combined as 'N=Nuts'. Live site blocks bots; verified via Oct 2026 snapshot.

name: Qdoba

likely_safe: Bowl with cilantro-lime or brown rice, black or pinto beans, grilled adobo chicken or steak, fajita veggies, pico de gallo, salsa verde or roja, hand-crafted guacamole, romaine (no queso, cheese, sour cream, chile crema, flour tortilla or chips)

likely_safe: Bowl with white-meat or adobo chicken, cilantro-lime rice, grilled veggies, guacamole, pico de gallo, housemade or tomatillo salsa, lettuce (no beans, queso, cheese, sour cream, ground beef or sauces)

name: Sweetgreen
